title: Keep Buffs on Death
description: Players can inherit various states from before death through a certain method, which can also serve as a survival effect.
body: This mod achieves the retention of various pre-death effects by canceling the fatal damage and teleporting the player to the Overworld spawn point when they take lethal damage — alternatively, you can regard it as a survival effect. Of course, this effect has a cap, and you will die once this cap is reached. The cap can be configured in the game rules menu. Additionally, since this mod works by canceling fatal damage, please note that you may miss some in-game events that require death to trigger. P.S.: As you do not truly die when the effect is activated, this mod is theoretically compatible with any mod that adds survival stats (such as thirst, stamina, etc.  /siwajich false  Enter this command to disable the mod in the game
